summary: Sandbach continue their impressive recent form, having scored 14 goals in their last three games with back-to-back victories, and now travel to face Brereton Social at the Red Lion Stadium in what will be their first visit to that ground. The opposition are seeking their first home win of the season, so it promises to be a competitive encounter. The club have also secured several new player sponsors, including Nathan Barry (number 9) sponsored by Gary Cooke and Jake Pollard backed by Martyn Sanderson's heating and plumbing business.
